name: NGC 2188 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2188, a barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2188-hubble
story: We see NGC 2188 almost exactly edge-on: its center and spiral arms are tilted away from us, so only the narrow outer edge of its disk shows, like a dinner plate viewed from the side.

claims.text: NGC 2188 is a barred spiral galaxy
Its center and spiral arms are tilted away from us, leaving only the narrow outer edge of the disk visible
The view is compared to seeing a dinner plate edge-on
